verdict.rationale: Per-end-user credential isolation is a fair question for an agent framework like Mastra, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions connected accounts, per-user OAuth, or scoped tokens. Thread-aware storage and model routing are adjacent features and do not deliver per-user credential separation.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can maintain separate connected accounts and scoped tokens per end user of my product, so each user's agent acts only on that user's credentials
